market_wrap.text: Nifty rebounded 1.14% to 25,514 and the Sensex added about 990 points in a broad-based rally led by autos (Maruti up 7.6%) and banks, with Nifty Bank closing above 63,000 for the first time; IT was the one weak spot, falling for a third session as TCS and Infosys slipped. Your stocks and ETFs fell 0.4% despite the rally because silver and gold dropped again. Today's mutual-fund NAVs were still not on AMFI at 10:07 PM IST, so fund values (and most of the day's ₹6,807 fall) reflect 18 November, when silver and mid caps slid.

reasons.reason: These NAVs are for 18 November, when MCX silver fell by about ₹9,000 a kg as investors unwound positions on a strong dollar and bets on a December US Fed rate rise. Silver slipped further on 19 November (below $45 an ounce) after hawkish Fed minutes, so the next NAVs may also be weak.

No company news found today. Netweb rose even as Nifty IT fell; it had filed that management would meet a group of investors today, and the stock has been recovering from its 6 November low after a strong September quarter.
No company news found today. The gain came on a strong day for small caps and air-conditioning names (Voltas jumped about 9%), after KRN had slid for several sessions to well below its recent highs.
Moved with the broad market rally (Nifty Metal up about 0.6% by the snapshot's data), recovering part of yesterday's fall when copper hit a five-month low. No company-specific news.

news.headline: Gold at lowest since September 2025 after hawkish Fed minutes
news.summary: Minutes of the Fed's October meeting showed concern over sticky inflation and a governor floated a 50 bp rise; markets now price about a 90% chance of a December hike, pushing gold to a 14-month low and silver below $45.

events.detail: Shareholders vote on the new Chairman (Mudit Kumar Singh) and Managing Director (Deep Saraf); the e-voting cut-off date is 20 November.
Meeting runs 2–4 December. The RBI raised rates in October; another rise would weigh on your bond fund and on small and mid caps.
Meeting runs 8–9 December; markets expect a rate rise, the main pressure on silver and gold lately.
events.affects: Silver and gold funds (about 30% of the portfolio)

events.detail: Companies usually report from mid-January to mid-February; results moved Manorama, Hindustan Copper and KRN this quarter.

outlook.view: Gold fell below $3,800 to a 14-month low and silver lost about 3% as markets put roughly 96% odds on a December US rate rise; the Silver Institute still projects a sixth straight annual supply deficit.
outlook.watch: The 8–9 December US Fed decision (about 90% priced for a hike) and the dollar.

outlook.view: They led today and have outperformed large caps this year, but they fall harder when rates rise or foreign investors sell.
outlook.watch: RBI decision on 4 December and foreign investor flows.

outlook.view: AI demand is lifting hardware makers like Netweb, but a global sell-off in AI stocks hit Indian IT today (Nifty IT −0.9%).
Record copper prices drove Hindustan Copper's profit surge, but copper has since slipped to a five-month low on a strong dollar and weak China data, dragging metal stocks.
outlook.watch: Global copper prices and the dollar.

outlook.view: The RBI is in a tightening phase, which tends to lower bond prices in the short term and raise yields on new bonds.
